# Imported MIT atlas tools — reference source (not live)

Upstream: https://github.com/CognitionLabSNUC/open-anatomy-atlas\nCommit: b2488616c5d7b8cb5b03bb9ee86eda911e3b6232\nLicense: MIT; keep LICENSE and NOTICE.md.

Wavefront OBJ, ZIP, BodyParts3D 4.0/4.3, Z-Anatomy importer, named structure hierarchy, renderer geometry/matrices. These files remain isolated from the live application. **Only code** has been imported; third-party anatomical meshes require separately documented rights and must pass scientific QA. Z-Anatomy bulk exports may contain NC and unclear-origin meshes: do not silently redistribute a whole archive. See tools/anatomy-3d/resources/README.md.
